subject: Kestrel: request for temporary feature/activation exemption to support ramp
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel - temporary activation exception ask for ramp (scope attached)

Marissa / Karthik —

Kestrel (KST-9217) is asking for a short-lived exception to our standard residency/activation rules to hit their go-live milestone next month. They want two things we typically gate behind product roadmaps:

- Warm-pool residency for an additional model variant (gives them predictable cold-start latency during peak time)
- A temporary higher burst concurrency cap for the first 30 days of activation

I've attached the MVP scope and the mutual action plan that spells out timelines and the proposed legal amendment. Quick context: they're a mid-sized wealth platform, pilot funded, and their SSO integration and ingestion pipelines are green. This exemption is explicitly tied to a 90-day pilot with usage caps and an SLA credit structure (see MAP).

Ask: can eng/product approve a temporary activation profile scoped exactly as in Kestrel_MVP_scope.pdf (section 2)? If yes, we need a short RFC estimating: effort hours, rollout plan (canary/regional), and explicit rollback criteria.

Trade-offs we understand: a warmed additional variant increases cluster residency and could nudge unit-costs up ~4–6% per token until cache settles. They have asked for an answer by EOD Wednesday (5/5) to keep their board timeline.

Attachments: Kestrel_MVP_scope.pdf, Kestrel_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if it helps.

Priyom

Thanks Priyom —

Looping Jordan for engineering impact and feasibility. Karthik / Neha: high level questions for product/partner teams so we can respond to their board timeline:

1) Is a 30-day burst with explicit usage caps workable without a code change (config + autoscaler tweak)?
2) If not, what is the minimum dev effort and is there a safe canary path?
3) If we agree, what are the exact rollback/monitoring conditions (token error rate, latency percentile, cost threshold)?

Internal note: Kestrel is willing to sign a short addendum and pay a modest commitment for that 30-day window. We should make any approval contingent on a rollback plan and telemetry hooks in Console (token-level cost by route + latency).

— Marissa

marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel - temporary activation exception ask for ramp (scope attached)

Marissa / team —

Quick feasibility readout from infra/serving:

- Warm-pool residency for one additional model variant: low-risk. We can provision a dedicated warm-pool tag and attach Kestrel's tenant to it. No model code changes required; config + scheduler update only. Estimated infra ops time: ~6–8 engineer-hours (staged rollout).
- 30-day burst concurrency cap increase: depends on magnitude. If they need a ~2x temporary burst over their committed baseline, that's doable by temporarily raising tenant limits and pre-allocating capacity; ops time ~4–6 hours to change autoscaler policies and test. Anything above 3x requires capacity reservations and may impact other tenants.

Proposal (compromise to limit scope and risk):
- Approve warm-pool residency for the specific variant in the scope doc immediately (can be done as a config change).
- Approve a capped burst policy of up to 2x baseline for 30 days, with telemetry gating. If usage approaches >80% of worst-case cost forecast, automatic throttle to baseline.

Monitoring / rollback criteria (engineered):
- Latency P95 increase > 30% sustained for 10m -> auto-throttle to baseline
- Token-level CPU/GPU utilization crossing 85% on nodes serving the warm pool -> trigger paging and reduce burst
- Cost run-rate > projected budget by 25% -> alert + manual review, auto-throttle if no mitigation in 30m

Next steps: I can draft a short RFC + runbook and schedule a 30-minute canary with SRE to validate flags. Need product sign-off on the throttle thresholds and legal to sign the MAP. Also need sales to confirm the exact numerical baseline for their committed throughput so we can compute the 2x cap.

Jordan Blake
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

From: Alyssa King <alyssa.king@kestrelfin.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Trevor Simmons <trevor.simmons@kestrelfin.com>
Date: Wed, 04 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel - temporary activation exception ask for ramp (scope attached)

Hi Priyom / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick coordination. We can confirm the committed baseline: 1.2M tokens/day peak (we expect average < 400k/day). The burst ask is to cover expected press-driven spikes during our launch week — target ceiling 2.4M tokens/day.

We're happy to sign the addendum in the MAP and to accept the auto-throttle conditions you suggest. Two asks from our side:

- Can you confirm the exact timing to enable the warm-pool residency? We need it active at least 48 hours before our public launch (planned 2027-05-12).
- Will the MAP include a clause for a one-time extension if we demonstrate sustained healthy usage?

Thanks — we'll have procurement ready to countersign once we have engineering confirmation.

Thanks,
Alyssa King
Head of Platform Integrations | Kestrel Financial
alyssa.king@kestrelfin.com

Team —

Thanks for the fast turn. Summary & immediate asks so we can get this to Alyssa by EOD:

1) Engineering green-lighted the warm-pool residency (config-only). Jordan to produce RFC + runbook; estimated ops time 6–8h.
2) Engineering agrees to a 2x capped burst for 30 days with the monitoring/rollback gates Jordan listed. Jordan: please include exact guard thresholds in the RFC.
3) Sales (Marissa/Priyom): confirm baseline number in the MAP is 1.2M tokens/day and burst ceiling is 2.4M tokens/day. Priyom: I'll attach the MAP and ask procurement to countersign; Marissa, please confirm commercial language for the auto-throttle credit.
4) Legal/procurement: Kestrel wants a one-time extension clause; suggest we offer a discretionary 15-day extension subject to SRE review and runway economics. Neha: can you weigh in on T&Cs?

Action items (owners & timeline):
- Jordan: RFC + runbook + thresholds (by 5/6 COB)
- Neha: proposed T&C language for one-time extension (by 5/6 COB)
- Marissa/Priyom: confirm MAP numbers + commercial note on credits (send to Alyssa once RFC is attached) (by 5/5 EOD)
- Ops: schedule 30m canary with SRE (target 5/10)

I'll draft the short response to Alyssa attaching the scope + MAP and stating the conditional approval once RFC/T&C are in.
